title: Pull request title and description gate
summary: Adds `osf pr check`, a new subcommand that reads a pull request event payload and the repository's PR template, verifies the title is non-empty, that every `## ` heading the template requires is present, and that each tool-written `<!-- osf:NAME:start/end -->` block pairs up exactly once. It then writes the hand-written title and body (tool blocks cut out) to `title.txt` and `body.md` so the existing `osf scan` and `osf lint writing` checks can judge the prose. The `hygiene` CI job gains a step that runs this on `pull_request` events, re-triggering on `edited`, with dependency-bot authors exempted.

nodes.label: osf pr check
nodes.subtitle: pr_check_cmd
nodes.summary: Reads the event and template files, parses the payload, applies author exemptions, calls the structural check, writes title.txt and body.md, and reports problems with exit code 1 (or 2 for usage errors).

nodes.label: pr_check module

nodes.summary: The structural logic: strips tool-written blocks, collects visible `## ` headings outside comments and fences, derives block names from the template, and returns the hand-written text or a list of problems.
